title: POCO F3 MIUI 13.0.6 / DND mode hurts BT to DASH
body:
My DND mode kicks in at 22:00 and I start getting pump unreachable (or _not sure basal was set in pump_ alerts) at the same time. 

I suppose this is a MIUI issue but here are the logs (in case AAPS can do something about it...). Look at the logs after 22h. 

AndroidAPS 3.1.0-dev-a
Build: 9e4864e93-2022.07.20-19:04
Remote: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS.git
Flavor: fullrelease
Version Nightscout : 14.2.5
Mode ingénierie actif

![AndroidAPS_LOG_1658348929572.log.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/9154303/AndroidAPS_LOG_1658348929572.log.zip)

comments.body: According to other users, flashing the POCO ROM with a new FW (without MIUI...) makes the phone work correctly.
